response.rationale: Options C, D, and B all map to the top-ranked leaf 'High-grade AV block' (joint_rank 1). Option C ('Complete heart block (trifascicular block)') and D ('Masquerading bundle-branch block (MBBB) with progression to advanced atrioventricular block') are both 'subtype_of' the leaf, while option B ('Advanced conduction system disease (e.g., possible progression to complete heart block)') is a 'supertype_of' the leaf. Subtypes are generally more specific and thus preferred over supertypes when all else is equal. Between C and D, both are subtypes with identical support and confidence scores, so their relative order is arbitrary but must be strict. Option A ('Ventricular tachyarrhythmia') is unrelated to the top leaf and is therefore ranked last.
